name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Iran fired on Kuwait, Bahrain 18 Nov
summary: Iran targeted a US base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain on 18 Nov after the US struck a missile site on Qeshm on 17 Nov
state: Early on 18 Nov Iran targeted Ali Al Salem air base in Kuwait and launched attacks on Bahrain; both said they intercepted the weapons and reported no damage or casualties (AP via Korea Times). This followed a US strike on an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island on 17 Nov, which a US official called self-defence after Iran's third attempted strike on a US installation in under five days (CBS News). Active strikes between states keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Kuwait, Bahrain and the wider Gulf, which can change at short notice. Regional airspace and flights may be disrupted.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states (US–Iran, 17–18 Nov) = Alert

sources.title: Korea Times (AP) — Iran widens Gulf attacks by targeting a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
